title: DESTINATION REACHED
physical_identity: A dark limestone cave reached by a shallow crawl passage; stalactites, cave drawings, handprints, claw marks, a cold campfire and three mutilated corpses.
scale_topology: Large cavern of unknown length; ceiling heights from under 2 m upward; interior only; entrance is one-way.
anomalies: Diary dates inconsistent with body decay
lighting_sound: No natural light; artificial source necessary. Sound not stated except dripping implied by leaking water.

entities.name: Unseen observer ('eyes')
entities.behavior: Only trace of an intelligent life form is the courier's feeling of being watched; no entity described.

entity_policy: NO ENTITY PER SOURCE (a watcher is reported by diary only)

entrances.method: shallow passage into a large cavern
entrances.conditions: remains found three metres from the entrance in Plane #445; exact entrance mechanism not stated
entrances.quote: a shallow passage, making movement difficult

signature_mechanic: One-way descent into a dark cave where being watched drives the traveller to madness; there is no way back.
verticality: None; ceilings vary in height, no stairs or levels stated.
